Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin prīvilēgium.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈpriʋileɡio/, [ˈpriʋiˌle̞ɡio̞]
  • Rhymes: -eɡio
  • Syllabification(key): pri‧vi‧le‧gi‧o
  • Hyphenation(key): pri‧vi‧le‧gio

Noun

[edit]

privilegio

  1. privilege

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

  • IPA(key): /pri.viˈlɛ.d͡ʒo/
  • Rhymes: -ɛdʒo
  • Hyphenation: pri‧vi‧lè‧gio

Etymology 1

[edit]

From Latin prīvilēgium.

Noun

[edit]

privilegio m (plural privilegi)

  1. privilege
Derived terms
[edit]
  • privilegiare

Etymology 2

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Verb

[edit]

privilegio

  1. first-person singular present indicative of privilegiare
